Task: Confirm business model: online-only, customer-facing storefront, or genuine in-person service; document eligibility evidence.
Resources: Owner; operating model, lease/signage/staff or service evidence
Deliverable: Signed-off eligibility decision and verified business facts
Success_Measurement: Eligibility decision recorded; no GBP profile created unless qualified.

Task: Research Pakistan market context and city candidates; distinguish broad market evidence from city query demand.
Resources: PBS; official market sources; competitor observations
Deliverable: City context worksheet with source dates and limitations
Success_Measurement: Every data claim sourced; city volumes remain unavailable absent tool data.

Task: Review local-intent keywords in Keyword Planner/GSC if access exists and assign intent.
Resources: Google Ads Keyword Planner (account), GSC (verified domain), analyst
Deliverable: Validated keyword set and page decisions
Success_Measurement: No invented volume; drop city terms without relevance.

Task: Decide whether physical location/service-area pages are justified.
Deliverable: Page/no-page decision and unique content requirements
Success_Measurement: No doorway/duplicate pages; NAP facts verified.

Task: If justified, draft one unique real-location page with hours, contact, access and local inventory/services.
Success_Measurement: No claims without evidence; mobile review.

Task: Audit/claim only eligible, genuine citations and check duplicates/terms.
Resources: Owner accounts; verified NAP; directory terms
Deliverable: Citation log for selected high-value platforms
Success_Measurement: Consistent canonical name/address/phone; no false listings.

Task: If eligible, establish/verify GBP profile; set truthful categories, hours, address/service area and photos.
Resources: Authorized business account; physical proof; policy review
Success_Measurement: Eligibility and profile accuracy pass policy checks.

Task: Set up GSC/GA4 and local-intent reporting; configure enquiry events.
Resources: Domain, verified properties, consent and analytics owner
Success_Measurement: Test events and filters; report no results before data accrues.

Task: Review local content, reviews process and quality; record next actions.
Success_Measurement: No fake reviews/incentives; identify unresolved facts.
